en: A black-and-white image showing a cityscape with a river running through the foreground, flanked by tree-lined streets and grand historical buildings. In the background, a hill with a large fortress and a prominent clock tower can be seen. There is a bridge crossing the river, and the streets feature some people and horse-drawn carriages, indicating an early 20th-century or late 19th-century period. The lower left corner contains a handwritten caption in German.
